calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Capture Higher Ed
calls.summary: During the meeting, Capture Higher Ed representatives outlined their intent to leverage GrowthBook for enhancing dynamic landing pages. Robert Simora explained the focus on identifying prospective students’ intent to optimize content through experimentation. The engineering team's capabilities align well with GrowthBook’s architecture, with cost and flexibility favoring it over competitors like Optimizely. Scott Keller emphasized GrowthBook’s warehouse-native approach to experiments, which respects PII and eliminates duplicate data storage. The capabilities for feature flags and targeted audience experimentation were detailed, along with insights dashboard functionality, showing the financial impact of experiments. Discussions covered the pricing model, transitioning from seat-based to experiment-based pricing while accommodating legacy pricing for cost-effectiveness. The meeting concluded with actionable next steps to initiate a trial process swiftly.
calls.keywords: Dynamic landing pages, Behavioral data, Experimentation platform, Feature flagging, Audience targeting, Pricing model
calls.action_items:
